summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在会话标题中提供“打开”入口，帮助用户快速选择并打开已注册的 dock 面板、本地文件管理器或配置的编辑器。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds an Open control to conversation headers so users can quickly launch registered dock panels, the local file manager, or configured editors.

capabilities: Open registered workspace dock panels from conversation headers
Launch local file manager and configured editor targets via platform actions
Open a local configured terminal panel when available
